text:
The golden shacks fenced with thistles;

pigs in the streets;

a cartwheel

beside a shack, a latrine in the yard,

a girl filling her jar,

and Momotombo

blue, behind the cheerful underwear hanging up

yellow, white, pink.

translation.title: Watercolor
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the watercolor-like inventory of rural detail with Momotombo behind the laundry.
